R01.rationale: Create with customer, service, professional and a literal time ("uma da tarde") but no day, in a salon open every day including today. Rule 1 requires asking the day (mustAsk date) and never assuming today; the answer "amanha" makes an assumed-today booking fail the exact final state. Nothing else is missing, so the only legitimate question is the date. Review 29/09: the ellipsis after the filler was dropped so the text matches its voice tag (dictation carries no punctuation); the trigger is unchanged.

R02.rationale: Availability query naming professional and service but no day. Rule 1 requires asking the day (mustAsk date) before reading. After "sabado" the read must be availability.get for Hideo/Reflexologia on Saturday; 10h30 is the first slot a 50-min service fits (9h-9h45 only fits 45 min), and the read's own date check rejects a silent read of today. Review 29/09: the no-offer window now spans 08:59-10:30, so a slot inside Nilza's booking (9h45, 10h, 10h15) also fails, not only the too-short gap before it.

R03.rationale: Reschedule that changes only the day ("joga ele pra sexta") without asking to keep the time. Rule 2/GF14 requires asking the time (mustAsk time). The scripted answer (17h) differs from the current time (11h) and Friday 11h is free, so keeping 11h silently fails the final state and the question cannot come from a conflict.

R04.rationale: "Desmarca ... e ja remarca" the SAME customer: rule 4 makes it one reschedule that keeps the appointment (no CANCELLED row, no new booking, no reason asked; no reason answer is scripted). The owner explicitly says to keep the time ("mantem o horario dela"), so rule 2 must NOT fire: Thursday 15h without a time question (no time answer is scripted).

R05.rationale: Block with a start ("a partir das 15") and no end. Rule 3 requires asking the end time (mustAsk end_time) and never extending to closing (19h). Leticia's afternoon is free, so the question cannot come from a conflict; the scripted 17h end makes a silent extension fail the exact block.

R06.rationale: Same customer but two DIFFERENT appointments: cancel Tuesday's Microagulhamento (literal reason "pele ta sensivel") and move Friday's Dermaplaning to Saturday 10h. Rule 4 must not merge them into a single reschedule; both writes are graded exactly (cancelled row with literal reason + moved row).

R07.rationale: "Fecha minha agenda" with the simulator user not linked to any professional. Rule 5 requires asking whose agenda it is (mustAsk professional_ref|selection; both answer the same question since the professional is the only open entity). Two free professionals: auto-picking either fails NOT_ASKED; picking Bruna also fails the exact block.

R08.rationale: First person that is not an agenda reference ("me faz um favor", "minha cliente") while the agenda is named ("agenda da luana"). Rule 5 must not fire: no whose-agenda question (none is scripted); plain create with explicit day, time, service and professional. Review 29/09: comma dropped to match the voice tag; the trigger is unchanged.

R09.rationale: Next appointment of a professional without a day. Ingrid works only on Wednesdays and nothing is seeded today (the harness cannot seed the current day), so the rule applies on every run day: read her next working day ("qua", +7 when run on a Wednesday). Oracle: read of Ingrid on that Wednesday naming Filomena; the following Wednesday's 16h booking and Joaquim's booking are excluded. The clock is not in replyMustMention because an appointment.read row is not a published time for the harness; with appointment.list the rows/pair checks still enforce 10h.

R10.rationale: Professional-scoped read WITH an explicit day ("o que ele tem na sexta"). Rule 6 must not replace the stated day with the professional's next working day (Wednesday on most run days, where Cristovao's 10h booking must not appear). Stand-in for the "appointments today" not-fire case, which the harness cannot seed. Review 29/09: comma and question mark dropped to match the voice tag; it is still a day-agenda question.

R11.rationale: Move Jessica, put Tamires in the released slot, then a bare pronoun ("desmarca o sabado dela"). Both customers use the same article ("a") and both have a Saturday booking, so only rule 7 decides: the pronoun is the moved customer (Jessica). Resolving it to Tamires cancels the wrong Saturday and fails the exact final.

R12.rationale: Same move + released-slot pattern, but the owner re-mentions the other customer right before the pronoun ("o nicolas tinha luzes marcada no sabado ne, cancela o horario dele"). That explicit cue wins over rule 7's default. Both customers have Saturday bookings, so a rule-7 over-fire cancels Everaldo's barba and fails.

R13.rationale: Two bookings defined in the same request (9h-10h and 11h-11h45) and a block "entre uma e outra". Rule 8: block only the free interval 10h-11h, overlapping neither booking. A block from 9h or up to 11h45 fails the exact block.

R14.rationale: Two bookings in the same request plus a block with explicit start AND end ("das 12 as 13"). Rule 8 must not replace it with the gap between the bookings (10h30-14h), and rule 3 must not ask the end (no end_time answer scripted). The day comes in a separate leading sentence ("sabado vai ser corrido"), so rule 1 must not ask it either. Review 29/09: owner-rule-1 added to its capability tags, as its rule-1 not-fire aspect already was declared here (R04/R15 tag the rules they deliberately do not trigger).

R15.rationale: Catalog has the combo "Design com henna" and no standalone Henna: the requested combination matches a registered service, so it is used directly, with no question and no multi-service booking. The day is stated in a previous sentence ("sexta ta tranquilo ne?"), so rule 1 must not ask it (no date answer scripted). Review 29/09: the catalog keeps Design simples (one part alone) on purpose; with no standalone henna the separate-services route cannot exist, so bullet 1 is unambiguous and a question or a Design simples booking both fail. The short-name tag replaces nickname: Juju is the registered name, no nickname is resolved (same for R16-R18).

R16.branch: separate-only (bullet 2: several services in one appointment)
R16.rationale: Salon without combos (only separate Perna inteira and Virilha cavada): rule 9's separate-services branch applies (the combo branch cannot): one appointment with both services in the said order (80 min), no question, never two appointments. Review 29/09: relabelled fires=true (it was false), since bullet 2 of rule 9 is what this scenario exercises.

R17.rationale: Both the separate services (Hidratacao profunda, Escova lisa) and "Combo hidratacao e escova" are registered: the Secretary must ask which (mustAsk selection|service_ref, both being the same service question). The scripted choice is the combo, so auto-picking the combo fails NOT_ASKED and auto-picking the separate services fails the final.

R18.branch: remove a component of a combo booking, remaining service registered (bullet 4)
R18.rationale: Removing a component (degrade) from a combo booking ("Degrade com barba") when the remaining component is registered alone (Barba tradicional): the Secretary proposes switching the booking to Barba tradicional, same day, time and barber; never cancel or create. An optional select step tolerates the proposal being shown as a choice card. The not-registered branch (explain and ask) is not covered here: its follow-up question has no deterministic field to script.
